events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect the VIP comment, repo state, publish hold log and probes
events.input: $ git grep -n -i 'build pass' -- app/src/app/vip; sed -n 1,12p app/src/app/vip/vip-client.tsx; git status --short | head -20; git log --oneline origin/main..main | head; grep -n -i -B2 -A8 'publish held\|T-141' coord/LOG.md 2>/dev/null | tail -60; ls app/scripts 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E 'vip|workshop|probe' | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check whether the fix is already on origin and read related task logs
events.input: $ git fetch origin 2>&1 | tail -2; git remote -v | head -4; echo "ahead: $(git rev-list --count origin/main..main) behind: $(git rev-list --count main..origin/main)"; echo '--- origin copy:'; git show origin/main:app/src/app/vip/vip-client.tsx | sed -n 6,8p; git grep -i -c 'build pass' origin/main -- app/src/app/vip; git log --oneline -3 origin/main -- app/src/app/vip/vip-client.tsx; echo '--- task log'; python3 - <<'E'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Fetch the two live mirror pages and scan for retired wording
events.input: $ cd /tmp && for p in site/vip/ site/vip/success/; do curl -s -o /tmp/vip_$(echo $p|tr -d /).html -w "$p %{http_code} %{size_download}\n" "https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/$p?v=$(date +%s)"; done; grep -o -i 'build pass' /tmp/vip_sitevip.html /tmp/vip_sitevipsuccess.html | wc -l

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check for VIP source changes since the fix and run the type check
events.input: $ echo "vip changes since f221b82:"; git log --oneline f221b82..main -- app/src/app/vip app/src/components | head; git status --short app | head -5; ls app/scripts | grep -i vip; cd app && (npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "tsc exit ${pipestatus[1]}")
